us-senate.note: Town and ward figures from the Secretary of State's workbook as OpenElections keeps it (a copy, not marked official: the Secretary's site refuses programs); the workbook's own totals are the control. MEDSL's compilation prints other figures for Canaan, Donald C. Bolduc: workbook 633, compilation 930; Canaan, Maggie Hassan: workbook 930, compilation 633. The statewide or district figure is the Clerk of the House's (official) and the store's check compares the towns with it; the winner is marked from it. Canaan: the workbook copy prints Donald C. Bolduc 633, Maggie Hassan 930; MEDSL's compilation prints Donald C. Bolduc 930, Maggie Hassan 633. Only the compilation's figures make the towns add up to the Clerk of the House's official figures, so they are stored for Canaan (the copy's are very likely transposed); every other town is the copy's. The FEC's statewide figures (Donald C. Bolduc 275,631, Maggie Hassan 332,490) equal the copy's towns instead, so the two official compilations disagree; the Clerk's are kept as the control, and a check names the difference.
